# AVA Rafting & Zipline

> > Colorado adventure outfitter offering whitewater rafting, zipline tours, via ferrata, horseback riding, and multi-day expeditions across the Arkansas River Valley and Rocky Mountains.

AVA Rafting & Zipline operates multiple outposts including Buena Vista, Idaho Springs, and Kremmling, specializing in Arkansas River and Browns Canyon adventures. The company offers combination packages, overnight rafting trips, UTV rentals, and guided mountain experiences throughout Colorado's premier outdoor destinations.

## Key Topics

## Adventure Packages & Combo Tours

- [White Water Rafting and Ziplining Packages | AVA Rafting](https://www.coloradorafting.net/packages/raft-zipline): Full-day rafting & zipline combo packages in Arkansas River Valley
- [Browns Canyon Half Day + Zipline Package](https://www.coloradorafting.net/trips/browns-canyon-half-day-zipline-package): Browns Canyon rafting + mountaintop zipline combo package adventure
- [Aspen to Moab 5-Day E-Bike Tour | AVA Rafting & Zipline](https://www.coloradorafting.net/trips/aspen-to-moab-bike-tour): 5-day e-bike tour from Aspen to Moab through Rockies to desert terrain
